name: permitSearchHelpHtml
description: Text for Online Permits Application/Permit Lookup Help modal
value:
Use this screen to search for applications or permits.  Note: When searching by the Site Address use just the house number and the name of the street without any directional or type (for example: 123 Main Street E should be searched by with just 123 and Main).

If only one application/permit is found then you will automatically be forwarded to the details.

If more than one application/permit matches your search then you will see a list of possibilities.
  • Use the Application/Permit number link to see the details of that item.
  • Use the Parcel Num link to go to About My Property for that parcel.
